requirements.description: Use Lux In Music product names and consistent package metadata.
acceptance: API and browser titles say Lux In Music.
Project and editable lock package use lux-in-music.
The generation CLI help still opens.
Project-owned files contain no retired branding.

requirements.description: Run studio with no models or engine and open Settings first.
acceptance: A fresh install downloads no model or separation weights.
Starting the studio serves the UI without an inference engine.
No usable active profile opens Settings and blocks generation.
Existing library audio remains accessible.

requirements.description: Run studio.sh on a fresh checkout to prepare software and open the studio without weights.
acceptance: Install missing uv locally, prepare Python and locked dependencies, and build the pinned native runtime.
Show software installation stages and native build progress before opening the UI.
Install no generation or separation model weights.
Repeat startup reuses a compatible build.
Missing system compiler prerequisites produce an actionable message.
The UI listens on 127.0.0.1 unless --host is given, and warns that the studio has no login when it listens elsewhere.

requirements.description: Keep shared application behavior independent of a particular model.
acceptance: YuE2-specific request mapping belongs in its adapter.
A fake provider runs the shared queue/result flow without audio.cpp.
The UI offers only capabilities reported by the selected model.
Generation and separation setup are independent.

requirements.description: Show model and component licenses before a user starts a download.
acceptance: Settings shows identifiers, restrictions, source links, and release revisions for the model and each component.
No download starts before the explicit user action and acknowledgement.
Unknown licenses prevent offering the download.
A release or license change requires renewed review.

requirements.description: Choose exact main-model and VAE precisions separately.
acceptance: YuE2 main choices include Q8_0 and BF16 using real artifact filenames.
BF16 is never mislabeled as FP16.
Selecting YuE2 defaults the VAE choice to F16 and offers F32 without auto-downloading.
Activation only accepts combinations verified for the selected runtime/device.
Models without a configurable VAE do not show a VAE selector.
Weight sizes and runtime memory estimates are displayed separately.

requirements.description: Download and activate complete model profiles from Settings.
acceptance: Downloads show progress, failure, cancellation, and retry/resume when supported.
Weights, VAE, tokenizer, and configs are verified before activation.
Existing valid files are reused without another download.
Activation failures preserve the last working profile.
The selected profile persists across app restarts.

requirements.description: Keep each job and song tied to its effective model profile.
acceptance: Changing Settings does not change queued or running jobs.
Song metadata records provider, model/VAE revisions and precisions, licenses, seed, backend, and effective options without secrets.
Old library metadata still loads.
Editing resolves the original compatible profile or explains which component is missing.

requirements.description: Guide song structure by duration and report forced truncation accurately.
acceptance: Keep a maximum-duration cap distinct from a composition target.
Retain semantic and score truncation flags.
A complete-song result requires ending evidence and a listening check.
Validate a reasonable 3- or 4-minute request with its profile, seed, and actual duration recorded.

requirements.description: Honor an explicit style BPM and report the best plan when Complete Arrangement cannot fit all lyrics.
acceptance: A single explicit BPM in the style is applied to the generated score before fitting, with every vocal bar preserved.
When every score is too long, diagnostics report the shortest measured duration and tempo among planner attempts.
An all-vocal score that remains longer than the selected target is rejected before semantic composition.

requirements.description: Infer and adapt song length inside a single generation flow from lyrics, style and tempo.
acceptance: One Generate request queues analysis, chooses an internal target, adapts safe instrumental passages and generates audio.
The browser, CLI and generation API do not expose or accept a manually selected target or length cap.
Vocal passages and the ending are preserved; an arrangement beyond model limits fails before audio with clear editing suggestions.
Variations reuse one checked arrangement with different performance seeds.
The song records the inferred target and analysis diagnostics without exposing the private score in job responses.

requirements.description: Start the shared versioned release process manually from main in GitHub Actions.
acceptance: Preview invokes the shared release script with full checks and no publication.
Publication uses the same script with a validated version and full checks.
Non-main refs, automatic events, invalid inputs and downgrades cannot start a release.
Release assets receive their version in a temporary source copy; main, README and CHANGELOG remain unchanged.
The release tag is the only ref pushed by publication.
